name: Mishio Aika
source:
The protagonist of this story. High school senior.
She is honest, cheerful and positive. However, she’s also quite absentminded, maybe because she has such caring childhood friends.
Likes physical exercise, but is not that great at studying. She also loves food, the sea, starry skies and photography.

[Translated from [url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]the official website[/url].]
